rule_text: Never place user-controlled input directly inside SQL strings. Use prepared statements or parameterized queries.
safe_patterns: Validate input shape and type before database access.
source: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
title: SQL Injection: Use Parameterized Queries For User-Controlled Input
unsafe_patterns: Python f-string SQL: `f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'"`
Python string concatenation into SQL: `"SELECT ..." + user_input`
SQL generated from request body, query params, cookies, or tool output without parameters
